[`LogFormat`] specifies which\n225\t/// parser to use for a given plugin. The format determines:\n226\t///\n227\t/// - How the file is read (streaming vs. random access)\n228\t/// - How sessions are detected (one-file-per-session vs. delimiters vs. queries)\n229\t/// - What fields are available for mapping\n230\t/// - Whether incremental scraping is supported\n231\t///\n232\t/// # Format Variants\n233\t///\n234\t/// ## Jsonl\n235\t/// **Best for**: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode (legacy), Pi, Goose\n236\t///\n237\t/// JSONL (JSON Lines) format: one JSON object per line. Supports incremental scraping via\n238\t/// byte offset tracking. Each line can represent an event, session metadata, or noise.\n239\t/// Requires envelope unwrapping for formats like Codex where lines are wrapped in\n240\t/// `{timestamp, type, payload}` structures.\n241\t///\n242\t/// ## Markdown\n243\t/// **Best for**: Aider\n244\t///\n245\t/// Plain text Markdown with delimiter-based session detection. Sessions are separated by\n246\t/// marker lines (e.g., `# aider chat started at YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`). Incremental\n247\t/// scraping tracks the last delimiter position to handle partially-written sessions.\n248\t///\n249\t/// ## JsonTree\n250\t/// **Best for**: OpenCode (current), some legacy Codex formats\n251\t///\n252\t/// Hierarchical JSON files where sessions, messages, and parts are stored in separate\n253\t/// files or database tables. Requires tree traversal and re-assembly to extract events\n254\t/// in conversation order.\n255\t///\n256\t/// ## Sqlite\n257\t/// **Best for**: Cursor, Windsurf\n258\t///\n259\t/// SQLite databases where sessions and messages are stored in tables. Requires SQL\n260\t/// queries with row ordering to extract events. Supports incremental scraping via\n261\t/// time-based filtering (`time_updated > last_scraped`).\n262\t///\n263\t/// ## JsonArray\n264\t/// **Best for**: Gemini CLI\n265\t///\n266\t/// Single JSON file containing an array of message objects. The entire file is read\n267\t/// into memory and parsed as an array. Does not support incremental scraping via byte\n268\t/// offsets (the array is rewritten in place), so falls back to mtime-based full rescans.\n269\t///\n270\t/// # Choosing a Format\n271\t///\n272\t/// When authoring custom plugins, choose the format that matches the agent's native storage:\n273\t///\n274\t/// - Agent writes line-by-line to a file → `Jsonl` (most Plugins are TOML files stored in `~/.agentscribe/plugins/` with the `.toml` extension.\n//! Each plugin defines a [`Plugin`] struct with three main sections:\n//!\n//! ```toml\n//! [parser]\n//! timestamp = \"timestamp\"\n//! role = \"message.role\"\n//! content = \"message.content\"\n//! ```\n//!\n//! # Bundled Plugins\n//!\n//! AgentScribe ships with plugins for:\n//! - **Claude Code** (`claude-code.toml`) - JSONL format with session metadata files\n//! - **Aider** (`aider.toml`) - Markdown format with delimiter-based session detection\n//! - **OpenCode** (`opencode.toml`) - SQLite format with JSON tree extraction\n//! - **Codex** (`codex.toml`) - JSONL format with envelope unwrapping\n//! - **Cursor** (`cursor.toml`) - SQLite format with KV store extraction\n//! - **Windsurf** (`windsurf.toml`) - SQLite format similar to Cursor\n//!\n//! # Custom Plugins\n//!\n//! Plugins are validated at load time for:\n//! - Required fields (name, version, paths, format)\n//! - Valid format values (jsonl, markdown, json-tree, sqlite, json-array)\n//! - Valid session detection methods for the chosen format\n//! - Valid envelope routing actions (event, meta, skip)\n//! - Path expansion and accessibility\n//!\n//! type_routing: std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,\n) -> Plugin {\n    use std::collections::HashMap;\n\n    // Configure role_map for common transformations (toolResult -> tool_result)\n    let \"envelope-test\".to_string(),\n            version: \"1.0\".to_string(),\n        },\n        source: Source {\n            paths: vec![glob.to_string()],\n            exclude: vec![],\n            format: LogFormat::Jsonl,\n            session_detection: SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession {\n                session_id_from: SessionIdSource::Filename,\n            },\n            tree: None,\n \"type\".to_string(),\n                type_routing,\n            }),\n            array: None,\n        },\n        parser: Parser {\n            // After envelope unwrapping, fields are accessed from the payload\n            timestamp: Some(\"timestamp\".to_string()), // Uses wrapper timestamp (^timestamp)\n            role: Some(\"role\".to_string()),           // From message.role\n            content: Some(\"content\".to_string()),     // From message.content\n            tool_name: Some(\"toolName\".to_string()),  // From message.toolName for tool results\n            project: Some(FilePathExtraction {\n                tool_call_field: None,\n                content_regex: Some(true),\n            }),\n            ..Default::default()\n        },\n        metadata: None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Read RSS (Resident Set Size) in kilobytes from /proc/self/status.\n/// Returns None on non-Linux platforms.\nfn current_rss_kb() -> Option<u64> {\n    #[cfg(target_os = \"linux\")]\n    {\n        let status = fs::read_to_string(\"/proc/self/status\").ok()?;\n        for line in status.lines() {\n            if line.starts_with(\"VmRSS:\") {\n                let kb: u64 = line\n                    .split_whitespace()\n                    .nth(1)\n                    .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())?;\n                return Some(kb);\n            }\n        }\n        None\n    }\n    #[cfg(not(target_os = \"linux\"))]\n    {\n        None\n    }\n}\n\n/// Load events from a JSONL session file.\nfn load_events_from_jsonl(path: &Path) -> Vec<Event> {\n    let content = fs::read_to_string(path).expect(\"failed to read jsonl\");\n    let mut events = Vec::new();\n    for line in content.lines() {\n        let line = line.trim();\n        if line.is_empty() {\n            continue;\n        }\n        // Parse the raw fixture format (Claude Code native format)\n        if let Ok(raw) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(line) {\n            // Extract role and content from the Claude Code format\n            let role_str = raw\n                .get(\"message\")\n                .and_then(|m| m.get(\"role\"))\n                .and_then(|r| r.as_str())\n                .unwrap_or(\"user\");\n            let content = raw\n                .get(\"message\")\n                .and_then(|m| m.get(\"content\"))\n                .and_then(|c| c.as_str())\n                .unwrap_or(\"\")\n                .to_string();\n\n            // Skip non-conversation events (progress, file-history-snapshot)\n            let event_type = raw.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"\");\n            if matches!(event_type, \"progress\" | \"file-history-snapshot\") {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let role = match role_str {\n                \"user\" => Role::User,\n                \"assistant\" => Role::Assistant,\n                \"tool_call\" => Role::ToolCall,\n                \"tool_result\" => Role::ToolResult,\n                \"system\" => Role::System,\n                _ => Role::User,\n            };\n\n            let ts = raw\n                .get(\"timestamp\")\n                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<chrono::DateTime<Utc>>().ok())\n                .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);\n\n            let session_id = raw\n                .get(\"sessionId\")\n                .and_then(|s| s.as_str())\n                .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                .to_string();\n\n            let mut event = Event::new(ts, session_id, \"claude-code\".to_string(), role, content);\n\n            // Set tool name if present\n            if let Some(tool) = raw\n                .get(\"message\")\n                .and_then(|m| m.get(\"tool\"))\n                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n            {\n                event = event.with_tool(Some(tool.to_string()));\n            }\n\n            events.push(event);\n        }\n    }\n    events\n}\n\n/// Build a minimal manifest from events with a known turn count.\nfn make_manifest(session_id: &str, agent: &str, events: &[Event]) -> SessionManifest {\n    let turns = agent.to_string());\n    m.turns = turns;\n    m.started = events.first().map(|e| e.ts).unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);\n    m.ended = events.last().map(|e| e.ts);\n    m\n}\n\n// ─── Per-agent scrape tests
